title: Marguerite and the Parish
author: Beatrix Thornbury
blurb: Jonah Coldharbour, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the statute expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
